import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    a = data[2:2 + m]
    cnt = [0] * (n + 1)
    best = 0
    best_cnt = 0
    out = []
    for x in a:
        v = int(x)
        cnt[v] += 1
        c = cnt[v]
        if c > best_cnt or (c == best_cnt and v < best):
            best = v
            best_cnt = c
        out.append(best)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(map(str, out)) + "\n")

main()
